MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Taxonomy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Physiology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fish cage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
